blocks.text: SHANGHAI — Novak Djokovic was knocked out of the Shanghai Masters after a shock second-round loss to Hubert Hurkacz on Friday. The 39-year-old great was beaten 6-4, 6-3 in a match that lasted just 87 minutes. The 24-time major champion Djokovic’s defeat came after victory in the China Open final in Beijing earlier this week.
